Row two: (1) a much larger irregular scorched black torn gap with layered jagged cold gray metal rim, (2) elongated burnt-out torn seam panel with ash-dark center and a broken kink across the middle, (3) a cluster of darkened orange-brown burnt metal pores with small black chips. Transparent ALL around the shapes, no rectangular background, no intact armor panels, no tanks, no flames, no bodies, no outlines around the grid, no text. Hard stepped silhouette and short dark edging, sized for readable game sprites.
artUsage: 2D tank coordinates are registered against the live atlases. The two 3D masks are projected across existing armor surfaces without changing source meshes.
